messages:
olga: sharing a new direction for pool rows — aim: single-line density but clearer affordances for min/max, SLO, and burst. mock: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/pool-rows-v4 (frames Compact-1/Compact-2)
emma: love the density. one concern: users keep confusing the tiny burst badge for a status chip. can we make it a real control (icon button) with a visible focus ring and a micro caret for the popover?
hugo: engineering: if burst opens a dialog we need focus trap + escape to close. steppers must accept arrow keys and be adjustable by typing a number directly. saving: debounce 600ms, persist last burst quanta per pool to local storage.
priya: accessibility: burst control must include aria-label that mentions the pool name. stepper updates should be announced via aria-live="polite". ensure all interactive text is >=4.5:1 contrast for 12px. also tab order should be: min -> max -> SLO -> burst.
sam: copy nit: swap 'Burst capacity' to 'Short burst' and change help text to "Short burst: temporary extra capacity for sudden traffic". guardrail language needs to be less scary — change "may scale below your min" -> "may temporarily reduce capacity under extreme conditions".
olga: good catches. design note: add a 1px divider between steppers and burst so the row breathes. for expanded rows we'll show a muted microline: "est +$0.09/min • est p95 +11ms". condensed row hides microline but shows the cost delta on pool-switch hover.
emma: mobile/touch: condensed must have 44px touch targets. current 36px steppers fail Apple's guidelines. also ensure burst popover is reachable on iOS (use tap to open, close on backdrop).
hugo: performance note: don't fetch cost delta on every hover. compute client-side estimate based on cached model throughput numbers, refresh on pool switch. also prefer sending batched updates for rapid changes.
priya: adding checklist for PR: 1) aria-labels include pool name, 2) aria-live for value changes, 3) keyboard arrow support for steppers, 4) focus order validated, 5) contrast >=4.5:1, 6) tooltip <250 chars and keyboard-focusable, 7) 44px touch targets on mobile. please paste this into the ticket.
olga: I'll iterate and push v2: make burst an icon-button with accessible label, add divider, include cost microline in expanded, save burst quanta per pool, and include the PR checklist. aiming to ship designs to dev by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
